recap.text: Uzi Jesus is a level one hundred and forty undead totem card from Ecuador. He arrives on a cross in a shopping mall, speaks with a Texan accent, and shoots the Shi Maria totem before she skewers him through the chest. He refuses to resurrect Geraldo until Princess Donut apologizes, then shoots himself in the shoulder by accident. He returns glowing gold with two gold-plated Uzis and calls down Bullet Hell.

Uzi Jesus is an action-figure sized robot with a halo on a wire and a toy Uzi. He climbs out of a food vendor's storage bin with a meat skewer in his mouth to ride on Eris's shoulder. He wants to kill Florin, but Eris tells him they need Florin alive. He fires his toy gun at the Scolopendra heap and pokes the frozen Donut with the gun.

beats.headline: A totem with a catchphrase
beats.text: Subject is a unique totem card, held by the court, summoned for seventy-five seconds at a stretch. Level one hundred and forty, constitution two hundred, undead, origin Ecuador. The catchphrase is his own and the card prints it. I did not write that card and I decline responsibility for it.
beats.gist: Uzi Jesus is a level one hundred and forty undead totem card from Ecuador.

beats.headline: Opens fire on his own side
beats.text: First summoning, Mock Battle Arena, 1980s shopping mall. Subject arrives on a cross, sheds it, lands barefoot, speaks with a Texan accent and asks what happened to the crocodile guy. Princess Donut informs him that he shot the crocodile guy in the stomach. When the Shi Maria totem appears above him, Subject empties his weapon into her. She skewers him through the chest and demands that he heal her. He raises a hand as if to cast, and dissipates. Totem Killed.
beats.gist: Uzi Jesus arrives on a cross in a 1980s shopping mall and shoots his own totem.

beats.headline: Believe in me
beats.text: Practice record: Subject says yes to about every order and performs roughly half of them, then denies the other half. Asked to resurrect Geraldo, cleaved in two by a minotaur, he sits and claims he already has. He will do it, maybe, if Princess Donut takes back what she said earlier. She apologises for saying he is not the real Jesus. He weeps for her blasphemy, then shoots himself in the shoulder by accident. Crawler Carl sent Crawler Florin a sarcastic thank-you for the card. Florin laughed.
beats.gist: Uzi Jesus performs half of the orders he accepts and refuses the rest.

beats.headline: Gold Edition
beats.text: Donut combined Lazarus with Skylar Spinach, and when the worm eats Lazarus he splits back into the cards that made him, stronger. Out of the worm vomit steps Uzi Jesus, glowing gold, with two gold-plated Uzis instead of one. I hath risen again, he announces. Told to finish Quan off, he twirls them on his fingers and one goes off and flies away. With the other he empties a clip into a naked one-armed crawler, and his halo calls down Bullet Hell.
beats.gist: Donut combines Lazarus with Skylar Spinach, and Uzi Jesus steps out of worm vomit glowing gold.

beats.headline: A toy on the goddess's shoulder
beats.text: Sighting, Hungry Eyes Village: a small robot of Uzi Jesus, action-figure size, climbing out of a food vendor's storage bin with a meat skewer in his mouth and riding on Eris's shoulder. His halo is on a wire. His Uzi is a toy, or is hoped to be. He wants to go and kill Florin, who gave him up. Eris calls him her little pet and has him flip the coin. Eris tells him they need Florin alive, for now.
beats.gist: A small robot of Uzi Jesus rides on Eris's shoulder in Hungry Eyes Village.

beats.headline: A toy gun at the heap
beats.text: Uzi Jesus appears on the arena dirt beside Crawler Carl, still tiny, mouth an O, apparently unaware that Eris could take this form. He fires his toy gun at the Scolopendra heap, pop-pop-pop, and reports that there are a lot of people's auras inside. He pokes the frozen Donut with the same gun. Then he climbs a snake tail onto Eris's shoulder, and leaves with her.
beats.gist: Uzi Jesus fires a toy gun at the Scolopendra heap and pokes the frozen Donut.
